# Tutorial Resource Register — Verified Primary Sources (2026-10-25)

**Method:** Opened GitHub repository metadata and sampled official READMEs where relevant; consulted creator-platform help/education docs. **A repository existing does not mean its full walkthrough has been independently executed.** Recheck specific version/permissions before publishing every lesson.

These articles are **editorial examples, not official operational or payment rules**. See [line-by-line four-source audit](TUTORIAL-FOUR-X-REFERENCE-AUDIT-2026-10-25.md) and [value gate](TUTORIAL-VALUE-AND-MONETIZATION-GATE.md).

| Article / first-party GitHub cross-check | What to learn | What is prohibited or not independently verified |
|---|---|---|
| [StackChan voice AI by @noahduck283](https://x.com/noahduck283/status/2113948562354811274), [gateway repo](https://github.com/justhalfbit/xiaozhi-hub-server) | Demonstrate a real task and architecture; provide prerequisites, step tests and pitfall fixes | Device/API/subscription expense and security permissions require independent check |
| [Xianyu by @HytidelLegend](https://x.com/HytidelLegend/status/2086034016281747894) | Practical end-to-end commerce workflow, buyer/service plan and unit economics | Generic ecommerce isn't inherently AI; fake SKUs, misrepresentation and sales manipulation **rejected** |

| [Solo creator retrospective by @Zesee](https://x.com/Zesee/status/2081295201486663718), [dbskill](https://github.com/dontbesilent2025/dbskill), [topic-scout](https://github.com/Jingyi-Wu-Richael/ai-topic-scout), [compliance-check](https://github.com/Jingyi-Wu-Richael/douyin-rule-check), [digital-human-production](https://github.com/Jingyi-Wu-Richael/rachel-digital-human-production) | AI-assisted source curation → scripts → production → platform review → measurement and continuous iteration | Revenue and ad volume are **author claims**, no independent audit; dbskill is **CC BY-NC 4.0** |

| Official source | Verified practice | Adaptation |
|---|---|---|
| [X Articles](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/articles) | Hook, purpose, short readable sections, evidence, imagery, linked teasers; Article writer restricted to eligible tiers | Default full guide in GitHub; X 1–3 posts + image |
| [X Threads](https://help.x.com/en/using-x/create-a-thread) | Connected posts with extra context; X composer character indicators | Max 3 as user's editorial rule |
| [YouTube topic ideas](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/13616340?hl=en) | Group formats/target viewers and compare like-for-like patterns | Cluster tutorials by learner outcome |

| [YouTube chapters](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9884579?hl=en) | Descriptive segment markers for revisiting a procedure | Full screen recorded lessons later |
| [YouTube retention](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/9314415?hl=en) | Inspect drop-offs and rewatched segments | Improve confusing steps; data availability varies |

| [Xiaohongshu official note guidance](https://school.xiaohongshu.com/lesson/normal/af0fe7e97bb0433fac9da5d1df52b07f) | Search intention/keywords, clear titles/covers, true instructions, creator analytics | Searchable practical carousel; merchant-specific examples must not be generalized |
| [Douyin enterprise content course](https://school.douyin.com/premium/course/6901561449299050509) | Content creation, niche audience, fan retention and data review | Short screen demonstration later |
| [GitHub Actions tutorials](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/tutorials) | Concrete build/test activities and checkpoints | Make command/action verifiable |
| [GitHub Skills](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/start-your-journey/git-and-github-learning-resources) | Free interactive courses with built-in feedback | Make learner perform, not just read |

## Source-ranking policy

**Primary canonical implementation > official course/documentation > practical creator case with proof > community claims > engagement aggregators.** Store original source **URL, owner, version/commit, verified date, limitations and usage/derivative rights**; do not copy full original tutorials/third-party screen content without permission.

The problem "self-built node" is **not yet specified**: if it means a VPS service, cloud GPU, workflow node or WireGuard server, the safe instructions, cost, ToS and requirements differ sharply. [wg-easy/wg-easy](https://github.com/wg-easy/wg-easy) is a verified *possible* VPN administration source, **not approved as a generic step-by-step course** without specifying purpose, provider ToS, lawful use and threat model.

## Site technology decision

**Now:** plain GitHub Markdown `tutorials/<slug>/README.md` + sourced screenshots/code. Minimal maintenance, durable deep links.

**Later:** if there are ≥10 verified tutorials and readers cannot navigate them efficiently, compare **Docusaurus** for docs + nav/search versus **Quarto** for executable Python/LLM tutorials and books versus **Zensical** for a Markdown docs pathway. Avoid defaulting to old MkDocs Material given its announced May 2027 EOL. Do not deploy any site in V0.

**Review interval:** every 30 days for platform documentation/ToS; on dependency major releases for technical guides. Mark changed guides `needs_revalidation`, don't silently leave stale commands as proven current.
